titel: Bibi: Kosenamen auf Französisch und Deutsch
hinweis: Hörprobe vor der Vertonung: Spricht ihre Stimme die Namen sauber, ohne ins Französische abzurutschen?

gruppen.soll: Die Namen klar und natürlich, der Rest Englisch mit Akzent.

kandidaten.unter: You look at my fence like it owes you a report, Clipboard. Have you ever held anything?
Pass me the nails, mon lapin. Not all of them. Why would I need all of them?
My mother says Hase. It's a hare. In German you get promoted.
You've got mud in your ear, mon canard. No, leave it. It suits you.
You do numbers, mon chou. It means cabbage, don't look at me, I didn't invent France.
You keep coming back, ma puce. It means flea, and I can't get rid of you.
It's asleep on your arm, Bärchen. I don't make the rules.
Doudou, come here. I need you to do some numbers.
Mon loup. Chéri. Schatz. I'm trying them all on you, one at a time.
Spatz. My mother called me that. Now you know everything.
